mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. It is 76 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under clear skies, though with an air quality index of 52, you may notice it feels a bit hazy. We are under a Waxing Gibbous moon, though there are no space station sightings to report tonight.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students in the Verona Area School District. Students have until July 22 to submit their original artwork, with the community voting on the winners from July 28 through August 7 to decide what design will be featured on stickers in November.

We have plenty of fun ahead, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia or join the Quizmasters at Lake Louie, and the downtown farmer's market returns this Tuesday.
In our weekly police report, we look back to July 13, when officers responded to a call regarding a driver who was arrested for O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
Your craving for the flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl, can be satisfied starting when Culver's opens at 10 AM. It is a fantastic choice, so make sure to stop by today.
